STEPS TAKEN
• Met to identify potential revenue streams.
• Toured with Jason Sanchez and Sam Payne to visit examples of
  surplus properties the city currently owns.
    • Greenway requires 6’ on either side of concrete path.
    • Some areas also have drainage channel of 10’.
• Met with TJ Barttelbort to explore the surplus property process
  and how properties can be:
    •    Valued.
    •    Advertised.
    •    Negotiated.
    •    Brought before Council for approval of the MOU’s to accept bids.
